notes:
REF-BM-08: Selecting a list card opens an internal detail page rather than the original URL.
REF-BM-14: Search supports tag:name syntax, not #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: AND, OR, parentheses, and quoted operator literals work, but NOT is not implemented.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action implementation.
REF-BM-21: There is no whole-filtered-collection bulk action.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be authored and rendered as structured rich text, but Markdown input/parsing is not supported.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML/PDF snapshot facility is implemented.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot facility is implemented.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Persistent default sorting is implemented, but displayed-item and font-size settings are absent.
